sources.method: CHM labels w / h / l as (8.89, 24.45, 3.81) centimetres; exact conversion to millimetres multiplies each by 10. The source dimensions_mm.states.body is the museum cm line; l is mapped to depth. This is the bare console record, not an accessories set.

notes: CHM mass rounded to one whole pound is withheld. Source w / h / l labels are preserved as width / height / depth; projection inclusion is not stated.
The Microvision manual calls for a 9 V battery, but no battery measurement or media-slot direction is inferred from its diagram.
